summary_1line: A Rakshasa abducts Bhrigu’s wife Pauloma after Agni confirms her marriage; her unborn son Chyavana’s fiery birth destroys the demon and Bhrigu curses Agni.

image_candidates.scene_text: A boar-shaped Rakshasa races through the forest carrying the pregnant Pauloma as a radiant infant suddenly falls from her womb blazing like the sun.
The newborn Chyavana shines with blinding light on the forest floor while the Rakshasa collapses and burns instantly into ashes.
Pauloma walks weeping through the wilderness holding her infant as her falling tears form a flowing river that follows her footsteps.
